headline: JSW Energy Limited: NCLT-Convened Shareholder Meeting Notice (20 July 2026)
sum: JSW Energy notified an NCLT-directed extraordinary general meeting of equity shareholders scheduled for 20 July 2026, following directions from the National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, signalling potential restructuring or scheme approval proceedings.
detail: JSW Energy Limited filed a notice with the National Stock Exchange (NSE) on 18 June 2026 announcing an extraordinary general meeting convened by order of the NCLT, Mumbai Bench, to be held on 20 July 2026. The meeting concerns equity shareholders of JSW Energy. The specific subject matter (scheme of arrangement, merger, demerger, or other capital restructuring) was not disclosed in the exchange notice itself, requiring reference to the underlying NCLT petition and order. NCLT direction to convene a shareholder meeting is a procedural step under Section 230–232 of the Companies Act, 2013, typically preceding scheme sanction.
